name: Chia Yi Steel Co., Ltd.
summary: Established in 1974 and headquartered in Chiayi, Taiwan, Chia Yi Steel Co., Ltd. operates as a leading producer and distributor of cast components. While primarily catering to the automotive parts industry, its reach extends globally, serving markets across Asia, Europe, and the United States. The company's extensive product line features a wide variety of items, such as components for jacks, hydraulic valves, rolling rotors, and carrier supports. It also manufactures parts crucial for construction and agricultural machinery, marine transmissions, cranes, hoists, engines, and brake systems. Further offerings include spring brackets, railroad bases, elevator sheaves, pumps, bolt machinery parts, and various assembled products. Beyond specific items, Chia Yi Steel delivers comprehensive casting and machining solutions tailored for hydraulic, industrial, construction, and agricultural applications. The firm’s advanced capabilities are supported by state-of-the-art production equipment for casting, along with rigorous quality control processes and precision machining services. Furthermore, it leverages cutting-edge technologies like computer-based mold flow simulation software, 3D printing for sand molds, sand cores, and metal mold cores, and FARO 3D scanning solutions.
